text:
olivia: quick check-in on vendor roadmap sync for H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi. primary concerns: announcement cadence, preprod image policy, SI gate checklist, and firmware/driver windows.

sam: thinking 2-wave announce: Wave1 (H100/H200/B200) then Wave2 (MI300 & Gaudi) ~10 days later. reduces press overlap and gives SIs time.

mina: ops ask  can marketplace images be region-staged? APAC wants a +7 day listing buffer.

diego: MI300 still needs the rocm compat smoke tests for our preprod images. we'll need kernel backport docs for customers on 5.15.

nvidia_pr: H200 firmware candidate is in internal QA; security sign-off TBD. if delays happen we can publish H100 and hold H200 under embargo.

habib: for SI handoff, recommend pre-signed tags and a checksum policy. pattern suggestion: rwinf_<vendor>_<model>_preprod_YYYYMMDD. example: rwinf_nvidia_h200_preprod_20240616

marketplace_ops_bot: note: marketplace policy requires image + release notes uploaded at least 48h before public listing for a given region. staging supported.

sam: action: i'll draft a proposed calendar with wave dates + gating criteria and post by tomorrow EOD.

mina: ops will try to stage APAC listings +7 days but need final images 72h before staging.

diego: i'll produce a short SI checklist (kernel versions, checksum instructions, quickstart commands). will include this snippet:
```
# sample kernel backport steps
sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y linux-headers-6.1
git clone https://github.com/rw-inference/si-kernel-patches.git
./apply.sh --target 6.1
```

nvidia_pr: we'll push to accelerate security review; will confirm by Tue.

habib: fallback routing: if MI300 drivers slip, Dedicated customers get an auto-route to H100-compatible variant. product + infra to confirm behavior.

olivia: summary of next steps: sam -> calendar + gating doc; diego -> SI checklist + checksum files; mina -> region staging confirmation; nvidia_pr -> firmware sign-off status by Tue. react with :white_check_mark: when you accept the action.

sam: :white_check_mark:

diego: :white_check_mark: (starting checklist now)

mina: pending ops budget signoff for extra Gaudi soak

nvidia_pr: will update Tue after QA

marketplace_ops_bot: reminder set for sam at 2024-06-18 17:00 UTC to publish timeline.
